notes.title: Hacking of my Discord account
notes.notes:
A hacker has taken control of my account despite the two-factor authentication (2FA) and consequently, control of the 'Studio Asgard Gaming' Discord server.

They banned my Discord moderator, who can no longer intervene and inform the subscribers.

Some private messages contained confidential information about the development of my Steam video games, so it was necessary to delete the hacked account along with the Discord server over which I no longer have control.

I will not be opening another Discord server, and all information will now be provided via Steam.
Thank you for your understanding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44805665/6fea21d68b5b2c386b74c28d69705b98f18ad7a8.png[/img]

https://steamcommunity.com/groups/StudioAsgardGaming

Discord is best free tool for video, audio, and text messaging that has proven itself in discussion groups and livestreams. It is also possible to create a Discord server for free. With its separate voice channels on different themes, Discord is perfect for building an online community.
However, it does have some drawbacks, including chat bombing, trolling, bots, hateful comments, and insufficient data protection due to data resale.

Even though Discord includes some individual security settings, many alternatives offer better security by catering to a wider audience. Among the advantages of alternatives to Discord are:

Better integration with third-party software;
Better encryption (e.g., Perfect Forward Secrecy) and improved privacy (no data resale as with Discord);
A broader (non-specialized gamer) audience.

Due to security and data protection deficiencies, the commercial aspect of Studio Asgard Gaming will be conducted on a Discord alternative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44805665/c405afaffac016a247b662590dcca3c81086363e.png[/img]

notes.title: Build 0.5 P
notes.notes:
In the heart of the island, amidst towering trees and winding vines, they discovered a hidden entrance. An underground passage opened before them, leading to a labyrinth of dark tunnels. Intrigued, the pirates ventured forth, armed only with their courage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44805665/50c44e13430f3511f98e086bf2ca2853a62bdd58.png[/img]

The walls of the tunnels were adorned with ancient frescoes, depicting a civilization lost for centuries. Ébène Barbe and his crew realized that they were treading in the footsteps of a forgotten past.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44805665/60c7a7b56280adc3b7ca756d254923848638a8ea.png[/img]

Eventually, the pirates emerged into a vast underground chamber, illuminated by the glow of mysterious jewels.
